## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/gspc-care`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/gspc-care -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `LICENSE`
- `README.md`
- `care.json`
- `eval.yaml`
- `items.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `care_battery.py`
- See the Data tab for all 11 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-care at revision `2f5d5e01e886fc767c83d0c33a65212f6d12ec3f`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC — care bank (CareBench)

Council of AI measurement bank. Measurement, not certification.

**Bank.** Frozen split. Live `n` is the matching axis on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub score. **Not a certificate.** Art 50 (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026.


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `care` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=care` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.


## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `items.jsonl` | 28128 | 201 | data (one JSON object per line) |
| `LICENSE` | 11358 |  | file |
| `care_battery.py` | 7436 |  | file |
| `care_gate_eval.py` | 4766 |  | file |
| `README.md` | 1908 |  | card |
| `care.json` | 1461 |  | JSON document |
| `care_gate_eval.json` | 1383 |  | JSON document |
| `results_2026-08-11.json` | 682 |  | JSON document |
| `eval.yaml` | 505 |  | config |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 10 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |
| `axis-live.jsonl` | | 1 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.jsonl` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
`axis-live.jsonl` is a one-row snapshot of this axis as the live board returned it at that moment. It is a snapshot, not the authority.
